今天我看前面排队通过率都挺高的，手里都是黄的绿的，以为这周会松一点，没想到我还是被10043了。。。我分到的是一个黑头发的亚女，之所以没去黑哥那边是轮到我的时候黑哥那边排了好几个，亚女前面就剩一个了，再加上有西浦声明在手我还是挺有信心的就没好意思换人。

轮到我了打完招呼之后问我去哪，紧接着她一直盯着屏幕问我本科在哪读，我就和她解释了西浦是利物浦和西交合办的国际化学校，是和西交分开的，有自己独立的法人巴拉巴拉，同时我把两份声明给她了。我在解释的时候她一直在敲键盘，敲完把我两份声明拿到后面给主管看了，过了可能半分钟，回来就拿了一张白单。然后她拿我护照扫完问我能不能把这两份声明留下，我说当然可以，然后她就给我拒了说你这次的申请不符合。我问她为什么，她说单子上写了。

notes_en:
Today I saw that the people ahead of me in line were mostly getting through, holding yellow and green slips, so I thought this week would be more relaxed, but I still got 10043. I was assigned to an Asian woman officer with black hair. I didn't switch to the Black male officer because when it was my turn he had several people lined up, while she had only one person left, and with the XJTLU statements in hand I felt fairly confident, so I didn't feel like changing officers.

After greetings she asked where I was going, then kept staring at the screen and asked where I did my undergraduate degree. I explained that XJTLU is an international university jointly run by Liverpool and Xi'an Jiaotong, separate from XJTU, with its own independent legal-person status and so on, and handed her my two statements. She kept typing while I explained, then took my two statements to the back to show a supervisor. After maybe half a minute she came back with a white slip. She scanned my passport and asked if she could keep the two statements, which I agreed to, and then she refused me, saying this application did not qualify. I asked why, and she said it was written on the slip.
